sonnet.problem: Card 11 stops at "You are not your own…" and card 12 asks the baker to supply the next word of the line, "bought," which nothing earlier shows. Wrong answers like "judged" and "tested" are equally plausible, so it is a guess at wording, not a reasoned pick.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. ... The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The joke sets Papa Dorin's escape from the junk drawer beside the Lord's resurrection ("Raised from the DEAD, friend, and here I am still bragging that I got out of a junk drawer"). That makes a holy event part of the joke and compares it to his own story.
sonnet.rule: Holy things, like the ark, and the way Scripture is written are never the joke. ... Comparisons stay on the human side of the moment.
